email_business_rules.title: Source Email Journal Entries
email_business_rules.description: Source all journal entry line items from email_je_prep where document_name is email_journal and source_type is Email.

email_business_rules.title: Validate Company Code is 1000
email_business_rules.description: Reject any row where company_code is not 1000.
email_business_rules.exceptions: parameters:{reason:Company code must be 1000 for Accrual Journals}}]

email_business_rules.title: Validate Document Type is SA
email_business_rules.description: Reject any row where document_type is not SA.
email_business_rules.exceptions: parameters:{reason:All Accrual Journals must use document type SA}}]

email_business_rules.title: Reject GL Account Series 1000 or 3000
email_business_rules.description: Reject any row where gl_account starts with 1000 or 3000.
email_business_rules.context: parameters:{reason:GL account series 1000 and 3000 are prohibited}}]
email_business_rules.document_version: [Reject row if gl_account starts with 1000 or 3000]

email_business_rules.title: Expense GL (6100) Must Have Cost Center
email_business_rules.description: Reject the specific row if gl_account starts with 6100 and cost_center is NULL.
email_business_rules.document_owner: parameters:{reason:6100 series expense lines must have a cost center}}]
email_business_rules.document_updated_at: [Reject row if 6100 and cost_center IS NULL]

email_business_rules.title: Debits Must Equal Credits
email_business_rules.description: Reject ALL rows if total DR amounts do not equal total CR amounts. Batch-level check.
email_business_rules.exceptions: parameters:{reason:Total debits must equal total credits}}]
email_business_rules.tags: [SUM DR amounts must equal SUM CR amounts]

email_business_rules.title: Calculate Monthly Amount (Annual / 12)
email_business_rules.description: Calculate monthly posting amount by dividing annual posting_amount by 12.
